sn56.11:1.1: In the narrative following the Buddha’s awakeing ([pli-tv-kd1:6.16.9]()), this discourse follows the apparently fruitless encounter with Upaka ([mn26:25.1]() and precedes the teaching on not-self ([sn22.59]()). [ps2.6:1.1](). It is alluded to at [mn26:29.1]().
sn56.11:9.1: The related passage at AN 8.64 suggests that the tiparivaṭṭaṁ dvādasākāraṁ apply to the knowledge, not the truths.
